name: repo-relative-file-identity
body:
A source file's canonical identity is its path relative to the git toplevel, with `/` separators — free of its absolute path and free of its path relative to the directory passed to `apg scan`. The base is the repository root so that `apg scan <repo>` and `apg scan <repo>/src/tslib` mint the same identity for the same file. When the scanned directory sits outside a git repository, the scan root is the fallback base.

Acceptance criteria:
- Scanning the repo root and scanning a subdirectory of the same repo yield the same File fqn for a shared file.
- The identity carries zero leading `/` and zero checkout directory component.
- The relative base is stable across worktrees that are at the same commit.
